title: Track Down Logan the Liger
description: Track Down Logan the Liger — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Logan the Liger

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Go to Purpose-Pondering Peak off MutantMania's Level 7 and track down Logan the Liger.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Logan the Liger

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Eye of the Liger

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to Purpose-Pondering Peak off MutantMania's Level 7 and track down Logan the Liger.

Offer:

I'm worried, I say I'm worried that you're losing your edge, friend. You're not winning as strongly as you used to. And if you lose your edge, you'll lose fights. If you lose fights, you'll lose fans. When you lose fans, then you lose money. And if we lose money, then, well, let's not think about you losing your manager just yet.

You need to get your edge back and, Gosh help me, I think I know how you can do it. You may never know how painful this is for me to suggest, but you need to contact a certain guru. Mentor, that is.

His name is Logan the Liger. Once, he was one of the best competitors the MutantMania had ever known. Nowadays, he hides up in Purpose-Pondering Peak off MutantMania's Level 7. Friend, you need to find him and beg him to teach you his secrets.

Turn-in:

Greetings. You must have surpassed great difficulties to find me. To seek my help. But how can I help others, when I cannot help myself?

Please, go away.

Level range: 86–100
